factSets.name: Applicant Profile
factSets.description: Canonical shape of an applicant and their application. Stable across products.
factSets.declarations:
declare Applicant
  id : String
  age : int
  tenureYears : int
  region : String
  incomeAnnual : int
  hasDefault : boolean
end

declare Application
  applicantId : String
  productCode : String
  amount : int
  submittedOn : String
end
factSets.facts:
// Stated facts asserted at session start (insert).
// Leave empty if all facts arrive via Working Memory input.

factSets.name: Product Catalog
factSets.description: Product definitions and their hard limits. Arbitrary/negotiated values — correctly externalised.
factSets.declarations:
declare Product
  code : String
  minAmount : int
  maxAmount : int
  baseRate : double
  minAge : int
end
factSets.facts:
Product( code: "LOAN-STD", minAmount: 1000, maxAmount: 50000, baseRate: 7.5, minAge: 21 )
Product( code: "LOAN-PREM", minAmount: 25000, maxAmount: 250000, baseRate: 5.9, minAge: 25 )

factSets.name: Regulatory Calendar
factSets.description: Legislated thresholds and effective dates. Non-negotiable, non-learnable, audit-relevant.
factSets.declarations:
declare RegulatoryLimit
  jurisdiction : String
  maxUnsecured : int
  effectiveFrom : String
end

ruleSets.name: Eligibility Policy
ruleSets.description: Determines whether an application may proceed. Phase: SCREENING.

rules.name: Reject Underage Applicant
rules.when:
$a : Applicant( $age : age )
$app : Application( applicantId == $a.id, $pc : productCode )
$p : Product( code == $pc, minAge > $age )
rules.then: insert( new Decision( $app, "REJECTED", "Applicant below product minimum age" ) );

rules.name: Reject Prior Default
rules.then: insert( new Decision( $app, "REJECTED", "Prior default on record" ) );

rules.name: Accept Eligible Application
rules.when:
$a : Applicant( hasDefault == false, $age : age )
$app : Application( applicantId == $a.id, $pc : productCode, $amt : amount )
$p : Product( code == $pc, minAge <= $age, minAmount <= $amt, maxAmount >= $amt )
rules.then:
insert( new Decision( $app, "ELIGIBLE", "Passed all screening constraints" ) );
setFocus( "PRICING" );

ruleSets.name: Pricing & Discounts
ruleSets.description: Derives rate adjustments. Uses insertLogical so discounts die with their premises.

rules.name: Compute Final Rate
rules.when:
$app : Application( $pc : productCode )
$p : Product( code == $pc, $base : baseRate )
$total : Number() from accumulate( RateAdjustment( $delta : delta ), sum( $delta ) )

ruleSets.name: Compliance Guardrails
ruleSets.description: Hard obligations that override commercial outcomes. Phase: COMPLIANCE, auto-focus.

rules.name: Cap Unsecured Exposure
rules.when:
$a : Applicant( $r : region )
$app : Application( applicantId == $a.id, $amt : amount )
$lim : RegulatoryLimit( jurisdiction == $r, maxUnsecured < $amt )
rules.then:
insert( new Violation( $app, "REG-CAP", "Amount exceeds jurisdictional unsecured limit" ) );
insert( new Decision( $app, "REJECTED", "Regulatory cap breached" ) );
